items.english: Which of these answers best hits the mark, I myself do not know. I have done no more than list such moral judgements at the end of this tale, in imitation of the *Didacticism* of the Chinese novelists.
notes: Kept Didacticism in English and italicised as visibly imported, per bible; kept the disavowal flat so the three answers stay equally weighted.

items.english: — Fourth month of the fifth year —
notes: Left the date unresolved as in the Japanese, without supplying an era or Western year.

data.say: Drafted the closing refusal and date line in the flat reportorial voice.
